note_en: 是……的 highlights the when, where or how of something that has already happened: 他是去年才转到我们班的 "it was only last year that he transferred to our class." The transfer itself is old news; the point is the time. English does this with an "it was... that..." sentence, while Chinese puts 是 before the highlighted part and 的 at the end.
